note: SAP_BASIS 751 SP02 (S/4HANA 1610), recorded from the wire measurements of fr0ster/mcp-abap-adt#351 (2026-11-09), not captured by this repository: a fresh class ZCL_AI_ACT_PROBE in $TMP with one public method, saved inactive; each request sent the same single reference (uri, type, name). The issue reports the requests in this order: preauditRequested=true on /activation (ioc:inactiveObjects, nothing activated), preauditRequested=false on /activation/runs (404), preauditRequested=false on /activation (200, empty body, activated). This step: preauditRequested=false on /activation/runs answered 404; the system's discovery does not list /sap/bc/adt/activation/runs. The issue gives the body as "No suitable resource found" and says the system answered it localized; the English text stands for it. Its content type is not reported.

request.headersNote: Caller-supplied headers only, as the issue reports them; the issue records no other header.
